a.lede: After years without a major successor, Logitech’s Yeti 2 arrives with new features designed to simplify microphone setup and audio adjustments.
a.title: Logitech refreshes legendary Blue Yeti microphone with 3D voice tracking and AI denoising

b.title: Logitech's Yeti 2 brings the 17-year-old USB mic into the modern age
